name: Inventory Planning
brief: Safety stock, reorder point, EOQ and replenishment policy advice from actual demand history.
description: Consolidates the four free GMSoft planning calculators into one app. Computes safety stock (Z-score method), reorder point, EOQ (Wilson formula) and a recommended reordering policy from Item Ledger Entry history, writes them to the standard planning fields, and can optionally supply them dynamically at planning time via the Planning-Get Parameters integration events.
